This formula has a double‑bond equivalent of 2, consistent with a carboxylic acid containing one C=C double bond. A structure that fits is but‑2‑enoic acid (crotonic acid) with SMILES `CC=CC(=O)O`. This SMILES is valid and corresponds to the deduced formula.</thought>
<final_answer>CC=CC(=O)O</final_answer>
